title: docs(tonewood): recover + consolidate the tonewood reference library under docs/tonewood/
intent: Bring the tonewood reference library under version control as a single coherent unit. The library existed only as untracked local content (docs/tonewood/) plus seven already-tracked top-level analyses (docs/tonewood_*.md). This consolidates all of it under docs/tonewood/ with a README index: seven pure renames of the tracked analyses into the folder, the previously-untracked catalogs/comparisons added, the American-hardwoods guide expanded (Pecan callout, Elm family, Gum group, Plane/Sycamore + London Plane), and a new cypress back/sides executive brief. Documentation only.
behavior_change: none - documentation only. No code, schema, route, workflow, data file, or runtime behavior is touched. Adds/moves markdown under docs/tonewood/.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) Seven tracked top-level analyses (docs/tonewood_*.md) renamed into docs/tonewood/ (R100 pure moves). (2) Previously-untracked catalogs/comparisons and the README index added under docs/tonewood/. (3) tonewood_american_hardwoods_comprehensive.md expanded: dedicated Pecan (Carya illinoinensis) callout; new Elm family (Ulmaceae, 5 US species) and Gum group (Sweetgum + Tupelo/Blackgum) subsections; Plane/Sycamore section enriched with American Sycamore + London Plane; density-tier, regional, sustainability, and summary tables updated for consistency; all values sourced from wood_species.json (FPL-grade). (4) New cypress_back_sides_brief.md - annotated executive brief on Bald Cypress as a back/sides tonewood for cuatros, flat/round-back mandolins, and lutes, with cypress-species comparison and recommended-tops tables (radiation ratios computed R = sqrt(E/rho)/rho).
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Places a real, cross-referencing reference library under version control instead of leaving it as untracked local content (the F-11 anti-pattern). Pure-rename consolidation preserves history; additions are net-new domestic-species coverage and a build-decision brief. No production or data-file change.

commands_run: Species mechanical values (density/Janka/MOE/MOR) for all added/edited entries verified against services/api/app/data_registry/system/materials/wood_species.json (FPL GTR-282-grade).
Radiation ratios in the cypress brief computed as R = sqrt(E/rho)/rho from DB density/MOE; Sitka/Engelmann acoustic gaps flagged (not fabricated).
Non-domestic species deliberately excluded from the American-hardwoods guide (Australian eucalyptus 'gums'; European elms); Sycamore Maple flagged as a false friend (Acer, not Platanus).
